subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: It is often said that our large population is our main problem. (a) ⎯⎯ it is also true (b) ⎯⎯ a large population can be turned into a unique manpower in a country. (c) ⎯⎯, China can be cited. (d) ⎯⎯ her population is more than 1500 millions, she is progressing day by day. But (e) ⎯⎯ we are lagging behind in many respects.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) that (b) in fact (c) Though (d) as if/ as (e) and

subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: It is more than five deades (a) ⎯⎯ Bangladesh came into being. If we observe all the sectors keenly. We will notice that (b) ⎯⎯ the country is beset with so many drawbacks. (c) ⎯⎯ ours is a democratic country, the practice of democracy is partially hindered here. Corrupt officials take bribe (d) ⎯⎯ it were not a malpractice at all. Time has come to pull the brake against corruption (e) ⎯⎯ corruption should be regarded as a valid practice in the country.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) that (b) in fact (c) Though (d) as if/ as (e) and
